text: do ahead and delete them using the obsidian cli that way they are just moved to the obsidian trash and not permanantly deleted for you safety concerns

title: Move 85 LLM/agent blog-derived notes and 2 hub MoCs to Obsidian trash
body: Leon approved; obsidian CLI delete (trash, not permanent); then clean dangling lines in kept notes.

cmd: shale intent "Move 85 LLM/agent blog-derived notes and 2 hub MoCs to Obsidian trash" --body "Leon approved; obsidian CLI delete (trash, not permanent); then clean dangling lines in kept notes." && S=/private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/8a5849dd-c7ca-4b94-92bf-f2234cba474d/scratchpad && f="$(head -1 $S/del.txt)" && obsidian vault=LLMeon delete path="30_Library/100_zettelkasten/$f"; ls "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/$f" 2>&1 | tail -1

S=/private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/8a5849dd-c7ca-4b94-92bf-f2234cba474d/scratchpad && tail -n +2 $S/del.txt | while IFS= read -r f; do obsidian vault=LLMeon delete path="30_Library/100_zettelkasten/$f" | rg -v '^Moved to trash' ; done; obsidian vault=LLMeon delete path="30_Library/MoC/MOC - Agentic AI & LLM Agents.md"; obsidian vault=LLMeon delete path="30_Library/MoC/MOC - AI Software Engineering.md"; n=0; while IFS= read -r f; do [ -e "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/$f" ] && n=$((n+1)); done < $S/del.txt; echo "remaining on disk: $n"

S=/private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/8a5849dd-c7ca-4b94-92bf-f2234cba474d/scratchpad && while IFS= read -r f <&3; do [ -e "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/$f" ] && { obsidian vault=LLMeon delete path="30_Library/100_zettelkasten/$f" </dev/null | rg -v '^Moved to trash'; }; done 3< $S/del.txt; n=0; while IFS= read -r f; do [ -e "30_Library/100_zettelkasten/$f" ] && n=$((n+1)); done < $S/del.txt; echo "remaining on disk: $n"

S=/private/tmp/claude-504/-Volumes-DAL-Zettelkasten-LLMeon/8a5849dd-c7ca-4b94-92bf-f2234cba474d/scratchpad && uv run --with pyyaml python3 10_System/scripts/edge_lint.py 2>&1 | tail -12; echo ----; while IFS= read -r f; do t="${f%.md}"; rg -n -F "[[$t" --glob '*.md' --glob '!99_Archive/*' --glob '!30_Library/400_indexes/*' --glob '!90_Audits/*' . </dev/null; done < $S/del.txt | cut -c1-220
